blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Infant pose and shape estimation is essential for applications in childcare, developmental monitoring, and medical diagnosis. However, existing methods and datasets are largely designed for adults, and direct transfer to infants fails due to substantial differences in body proportions, articulation limits, and frequent self-occlusion. To address this gap, we introduce InfantNet, the largest real-image infant dataset to date, comprising 108,902 RGB images of infants aged 6-18 months. Each image is annotated with 2D keypoints, and a curated subset of 11,642 images additionally includes 3D pose and shape annotations with full SMIL parameters, verified through multi-view rendering and reprojection-error filtering. We use an iterative annotation pipeline to ensure high fidelity across both 2D and 3D labels. InfantNet establishes a large-scale, comprehensive benchmark for infant 2D keypoint detection and 3D pose-and-shape recovery. Baseline experiments demonstrate that state-of-the-art adult pose estimators do not generalize well to infants, whereas fine-tuning on InfantNet yields a consistent improvement. The gains are even more pronounced for 3D pose and shape estimation, where SMIL-based estimation demonstrates robust performance with accuracy comparable to results reported for SMPL-based models. By releasing the InfantNet dataset and benchmark, we provide a vital resource for advancing infant pose analysis and related healthcare applications.
blocks.zh: 婴儿的姿势和形状估计对于儿童保育、发育监测和医学诊断方面的应用至关重要。 然而,现有的方法和数据集主要是为成年人设计的,由于身体比例、表达限制和经常自我隔离方面的巨大差异,直接向婴儿转移失败。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了InfanteNet,这是迄今为止最大的真实图像婴儿数据集,包含108,902个6至18个月婴儿的RGB图像。 每个图像都以2D键点作注释,由11,642个图像组成的被曲解的子集还包含有全 SMIL 参数的 3D 姿势和形状说明,通过多视图渲染和再投射-error 过滤来验证. 我们使用迭代注解管道,以确保2D和3D标签的高度忠诚。 InfanteNet为婴儿2D键点检测和3D姿势和形状恢复确定了一个大规模、全面的基准。 基线实验表明,最先进的成年人构成的估算器对婴儿并不普遍,而对InfantNet的微调则带来持续改善。 立体模型和形状估计的增益更为明显,其中基于SMIL的估算显示,与基于SMPL的模型报告的结果相比,性能强劲,准确性可观。 通过发布InfantNet的数据集和基准,我们为推进婴儿姿势分析和相关的保健应用提供了重要资源。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Estimating the pose and shape of the human body is a foundational task in computer vision, with broad applications in action recognition, human-computer interaction, and healthcare [ 22 , 26 , 37 , 33 , 32 ] . Over the past decades, human pose and shape estimation algorithms have achieved remarkable progress. However, existing methods and datasets predominantly focus on adults, whose body morphology and poses differ significantly from those of infants. Directly applying adult-trained models to infants results in poor performance due to substantial domain gaps, including differences in body proportions, limited articulation, and frequent self-occlusion typical of infant behavior. These limitations significantly hinder the deployment of such models in infant-related applications, despite their critical importance in areas such as developmental monitoring, childcare, and early medical diagnosis.
For instance, quantifying infant micro-activities [ 32 ] requires fine-grained 3D pose analysis. However, in the absence of accurate infant-specific models, researchers [ 33 ] currently rely on keypoint detectors trained primarily on adult data combined with multi-view triangulation as a noisy proxy, which are complicated to deploy in real-world home environments.
blocks.zh:
估计人体的姿势和形状是计算机视觉中的一项基础任务,在行动识别、人与计算机互动和保健[22、26、37、33、32]方面有广泛的应用。 在过去几十年里,人类姿势和形状估计算法取得了显著进展. 然而,现有的方法和数据集主要侧重于成年人,他们的身体形态和构成与婴儿有很大不同。 直接将成人训练的模型应用到婴儿身上,由于领域差距很大,包括身体比例不同,表达有限,以及婴儿行为典型的经常自我隔离,导致性能差. 尽管这些模式在发育监测、儿童保育和早期医疗诊断等领域至关重要,但这些限制严重阻碍了在与婴儿有关的应用中采用这些模式。
例如,量化婴儿的微活性[32]需要精细的立体分析。 然而,由于缺乏精确的婴儿特异性模型,研究人员[33]目前依靠主要以成人数据为主而训练的关键点探测器,并结合多视三角化作为噪音代用,这些代用器在现实世界的家庭环境中部署起来很复杂.

blocks.en: A major obstacle to advancing infant-specific pose estimation is the lack of large-scale, high-quality annotated datasets. Existing infant datasets typically contain only a few thousand images [ 17 , 19 , 12 ] , in contrast to adult datasets such as 3DPW [ 42 ] and Human3.6M [ 20 ] , which comprise over 51,000 and 3.6 million images, respectively. Moreover, current infant datasets are often synthetic or focus mainly on sparse 2D annotations [ 17 , 19 , 12 ] , lacking the 3D supervision needed to train and evaluate modern human modeling methods [ 44 , 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 缺乏大规模、高质量的附加说明的数据集是推进针对婴儿的假设估计的主要障碍。 现有的婴儿数据集通常只包含几千个图像[17、19、12],而成人数据集则不同,例如3DPW[42]和Human3.6M[20],它们分别包括51 000多幅和360万幅图像。 此外,目前的婴儿数据集常常是合成的,或主要侧重于稀少的2D说明[17、19、12],缺乏培训和评价现代人类模型制作方法所需的3D监督[44、15]。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce InfantNet , a large-scale dataset specifically designed for infant pose and shape estimation. Comprising more than 100K high-resolution RGB images of infants mainly aged 6 to 18 months, InfantNet includes accurate annotations of 17 anatomically consistent 2D keypoints. Frames are sampled from videos at up to 2 FPS to reduce temporal redundancy while preserving pose diversity (Fig. 4 ). A carefully curated subset of 11,642 images further includes 3D pose and shape annotations by SMIL [ 18 ] parameters, enabling future research for 3D infant shape and pose estimation. We adopt a robust iterative annotation pipeline that combines human supervision with optimization-based refinement to ensure high-quality labels in 2D. We further validate 3D SMIL [ 18 ] parameters by predicting the resulting meshes from multiple viewpoints and computing reprojection errors. Examples of images and 3D pose and shape annotations are shown in Figure .
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了InfantNet,这是一个专门为婴儿姿势和形状估计设计的大型数据集。 InfantNet包含超过100K高分辨率RGB主要年龄为6至18个月的婴儿图像,包含17个解剖上一致的2D键点的准确说明. 从最多2个FPS的视频中取出框架样本,以减少时间冗余,同时保持形而上学的多样性(图4)。 精心整理的由11,642个图像组成的子集进一步包括了由SMIL[18]参数构成的3D姿势和形状说明,使得未来能够对3D婴儿形状进行研究并作出估计. 我们采用一个强有力的迭代注释管道,将人的监督与基于优化的改进结合起来,以确保2D的高质量标签。 我们进一步验证了3D SMIL [18] 参数,通过多种观点和计算再预测错误来预测由此产生的中间点。 图片以及3D姿势和形状说明的例子如图.

blocks.en: InfantNet is designed with a “privacy-first” data collection framework . The HomeVisit subset was collected under institutional review board (IRB) approval with written informed caregiver consent and digital face-masking. For the YouTube subset, we strictly adhere to a non-redistribution policy, releasing only original URLs and anonymized derivatives (keypoints, SMIL parameters). To prevent misuse, the dataset is restricted to research via controlled academic licensing, a signed Data Use Agreement (DUA) prohibiting biometric identification, and a robust takedown mechanism. (See Sec. 3.1 for details.)
blocks.zh: InfanteNet的设计采用了“先天”数据收集框架。 家庭展望子集是在机构审查委员会(IRB)的批准下收集的,并得到了书面的知情照料者的同意和数字化的面相。 对于YouTube子集,我们严格遵守非再分配政策,只发布原始URL和匿名衍生物(关键点,SMIL参数). 为防止滥用,数据集仅限于通过控制下的学术许可、一项禁止生物鉴别的已签署的数据使用协议以及一个强有力的取出机制进行研究。 (详情见第3.1节。 )

blocks.en: Our benchmark shows that state-of-the-art adult pose estimators generalize poorly to infants. Fine-tuning on InfantNet substantially reduces this gap, improving 2D performance by 6.2% AP and reducing 3D MPJPE by 78%. Despite training on only 10,071 frames, our infant-specific 4D-Humans model achieves 46.7 mm PA-MPJPE on InfantNet, approaching the adult result of 32.4 mm [ 15 ] trained and tested on the Human3.6M dataset, and surpasses HMR (56.8 mm) and PARE (50.6 mm). These results highlight the strong data efficiency of InfantNet, enabling high-fidelity 3D modeling with 350 × 350\times fewer training samples than typical adult datasets. Our model also enables significantly more accurate detection of infant hand-to-mouth behavior [ 33 ] , supporting reliable assessment of environmental exposure risks in real-world settings.
blocks.zh: 我们的基准显示,最先进的成年人对婴儿的印象不佳。 对InfantNet的微调大大缩小了这一差距,使2D的性能提高了6.2%AP,使3D MPJPE减少了78%. 尽管只接受了10,071帧的培训,但我们针对婴儿的4D-Humans模型在InfantNet上实现了46.7毫米PA-MPJPE,接近在Human3.6M数据集上培训和测试的32.4毫米[15]分的成人结果,并超过了HMR(56.8毫米)和PDE(50.6毫米). 这些结果凸显出InfantNet强大的数据效率,使得能以350×350\%的训练样本比典型的成人数据集少出高纯度立体模型. 我们的模式还能够大大地更准确地检测婴儿的手对口行为[33],支持对现实世界环境中的环境接触风险进行可靠的评估。

blocks.en: In summary, the main contributions of our paper are:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的文件的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • We introduce InfantNet , a large-scale dataset for infant pose and shape estimation, containing 108,902 RGB images with high-quality 2D keypoint annotations. A curated subset of 11,642 images further includes 3D pose and shape labels based on SMIL. The dataset enables comprehensive evaluation of both 2D and 3D pose and shape estimation models. • We develop an end-to-end SMIL-based framework for infant 3D pose and shape estimation. To our knowledge, this is the first attempt to directly regress SMIL parameters from images with neural networks. By generating high-quality pseudo ground-truth through optimization and verification, we train end-to-end models to directly regress SMIL parameters from images, enabling accurate infant-specific 3D modeling. • We systematically analyze the domain gap between adult and infant pose estimation. Fine-tuning on InfantNet substantially improves both 2D and 3D performance, demonstrating the importance of domain-specific data. Our models achieve competitive accuracy with far fewer training samples and support downstream applications such as infant microactivity analysis. • We set up a benchmark on InfantNet using state-of-the-art human pose and shape estimation algorithms.

blocks.en: By releasing data, code, and evaluation protocols, we hope to provide a foundation for future research in infant pose and shape estimation, with implications for early developmental assessment, clinical monitoring, and beyond.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: In this section, we discuss existing infant datasets and related pose and shape estimation algorithms.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们讨论现有的婴儿数据集以及相关的姿势和形状估计算法.

InfantNet is the largest real-world infant dataset to date, providing 108,902 images with keypoint annotations, full segmentation masks, and a curated subset with 3D SMIL parameters. In contrast, prior datasets are limited in scale, modality, or 3D supervision (e.g., MINI-RGBD provides depth only).
blocks.zh: 表1:婴儿网与现有开源婴儿的数据集比较。 InfantNet是迄今为止最大的现实世界婴儿数据集,提供108,902个图像,并附有关键点说明,完整的分块口罩,以及带有3D SMIL参数的被整理子集. 相形之下,先前的数据集在尺度,模式,或三维监督上是有限的(例如,MINI-RGBD只提供深度).

blocks.en: 2.1 Infant Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 婴儿数据集

blocks.en:
Human pose and shape estimation has benefited enormously from large-scale adult datasets such as Human3.6M [ 20 ] , MPII [ 1 ] , and AMASS [ 34 ] . In contrast, infant datasets remain scarce due to ethical, logistical, and technical challenges in capturing infant motion in naturalistic environments. Early efforts include BabyPose [ 35 ] , which provides 16 depth videos from NICU settings with 12-joint annotations, and the dataset from [ 16 ] , focusing on supine infants with limited poses. BabyNet [ 12 ] targets activity classification without fine-grained pose labels. MINI-RGBD [ 17 ] offers synthetic depth sequences of 12 infant models, while SyRIP [ 19 ] combines 1,700 synthetic and real images with sparse 2D keypoints. These datasets are small, often synthetic or modality-specific, and lack segmentation masks or 3D ground truth pose and shape parameters.
Our proposed InfantNet addresses these limitations by providing real infant RGB images with high-quality 2D keypoints, segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and 3D pose and shape annotations. Table 1 compares InfantNet with prior datasets, showing its unique scale, diversity, and multimodal supervision, which together enable robust evaluation and training of infant-specific models.
blocks.zh:
人类的姿势和形状估计大大受益于大规模成人数据集,如Human3.6M[20]、MPII[1]和AMASS[34]。 与此相反,由于在自然环境中捕获婴儿运动的道德、后勤和技术挑战,婴儿数据集仍然很少。 早期的努力包括: BabyPose [35],提供来自NICU设置的16个深度视频并有12个联合说明,以及来自 [16] 的数据集,侧重于姿势有限的supine婴儿. BabyNet [12] 目标活动分类没有细纹的外形标签. MINI-RGBD [17] 提供了12个婴儿模型的合成深度序列,而SYRIP [19] 结合了1700个合成和真实的图像与稀有的2D键点. 这些数据集很小,常常是合成的或模式特有的,缺乏分解口罩或3D地真能和形状参数.
我们拟议的InfantNet通过向真正的婴儿RGB图像提供高质量的2D关键点,分块口罩,边框和3D姿势和外形说明来解决这些局限性. 表1将InfantNet与以前的数据集进行比较,显示其独特的规模、多样性和多模式监管,这些组合加在一起能够对针对婴儿的模型进行有力的评价和培训。

blocks.en: 2.2 Infant Pose and Shape Estimation
blocks.zh: 2.2 婴儿Pose和形状估计

blocks.en: 2D infant pose estimation initially applied general-purpose models such as OpenPose [ 7 ] , HRNet [ 41 ] , and AlphaPose [ 14 ] , but these perform poorly due to infants’ distinct proportions, articulation limits, and frequent self-occlusion [ 39 ] . Later work fine-tuned these CNN-based estimators on small infant datasets [ 16 ] , reducing error and approaching human inter-rater variability. SHIFT [ 4 ] adapts adult data to unlabeled infant data, reflecting the scarcity of labeled infant-specific datasets. More recent transformer-based methods, such as ViTPose [ 44 ] , AggPose [ 6 ] , and Sapiens [ 23 ] , improve spatial reasoning in cluttered settings [ 21 ] , but are susceptible to overfitting without large and diverse infant-specific datasets.
blocks.zh: 2D婴幼儿最初采用OpenPose[7]、HRNet[41]和AlphaPose[14]等通用模型进行估计,但由于婴儿比例不同、表达限制和经常自我隔离,这些模型表现不佳。 后来的工作对基于CNN的小型婴儿数据集的这些估计器进行了微调[16],减少了误差并接近了人与人之间的可变性. SHIFT [4] 将成人数据与无标签的婴儿数据相适应,反映了无标签的婴儿专用数据集的稀缺性. 以变压器为基础的更近期的方法,如ViTPose [44],AggPose [6],和Sapians [23] 改进了杂乱环境中的空间推理[21],但是在没有大型和多样化的婴儿特有数据集的情况下容易过度调整.

blocks.en: In the 3D domain, early infant methods relied on depth sensors for direct joint prediction [ 17 ] or stereo systems for triangulation [ 40 ] , achieving good accuracy in clinical settings but requiring specialized hardware. The SMIL model [ 18 ] represents a key step toward parametric modeling of infants: adapting the adult SMPL template [ 30 ] with an infant-specific mesh and priors learned from noisy, incomplete RGB-D recordings. While SMIL enables full-body mesh registration, its reliance on limited and low-quality depth sequences constrains generalization. ZeDO-i [ 48 ] adapts adult priors with limited infant data, focusing on keypoint estimation. Other approaches leverage synthetic renderings [ 19 ] or alternative sensors such as pressure mats [ 13 , 9 ] , but these are less practical in daily settings.
blocks.zh: 在3D领域,婴儿早期方法依靠深度传感器进行直接联合预测[17]或立体系统来进行三角化[40],在临床环境中实现了良好的准确性,但需要专门的硬件. SMIL模型[18]是婴儿参数模型的关键步骤:用从吵闹而不完整的RGB-D录音中汲取的婴儿特有网格和前科来修改成人SMPL模板[30]。 虽然SMIL能够实现全身网状注册,但其对有限和低质量深度序列的依赖制约了通俗化. ZeDO-i [48] 以有限的婴儿数据来适应成人前科,侧重于关键点估计. 其他方法利用合成渲染[19]或替代传感器,如压力垫[13,9],但这些在日常环境下不太实用.

blocks.en: Despite this progress, the field lacks a large-scale, real-world RGB benchmark with consistent 2D and 3D annotations. Our InfantNet fills this gap, enabling systematic development and evaluation of infant pose and shape estimation models that generalize across naturalistic scenarios.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这一进展,但这个领域缺乏一个具有一致的2D和3D说明的大规模现实世界RGB基准. 我们的 " 婴儿网络 " 填补了这一空白,从而能够系统地发展和评价婴儿的姿势并形成各种类型的估计模型,这些模型将各种自然现象概括起来。

blocks.en: 2.3 Adult pose and shape estimation
blocks.zh: 2.3 成人姿势和形状估计

blocks.en: 3D human pose and shape estimation has been extensively studied through parametric models such as SMPL [ 30 ] and its extensions (e.g. SMPL-X [ 37 ] ). Learning-based approaches including HMR [ 22 ] , VIBE [ 24 ] , PARE [ 25 ] , and 4D-Humans [ 15 ] use feedforward regression to directly predict body parameters from images or videos, often with strong temporal consistency. However, these methods are trained on adult datasets and exhibit poor generalization to infants, whose body proportions, articulation limits, and frequent occlusions differ significantly. In this work, we adapt such adult regression networks to the infant domain using InfantNet and SMIL-based annotations.
blocks.zh: 通过SMPL [30]等参数模型及其扩展(如SMPL-X [37]),已经广泛研究了3D人类姿势和形状估计. 基于学习的方法,包括HMR[22],VIBE [24],价调汇率[25],和4D-Humans [15] 利用向后回归直接从图像或视频中预测身体参数,往往具有很强的时间一致性. 然而,这些方法在成人数据集方面得到了培训,对婴儿的普及程度不高,婴儿的体分、表达限制和经常被隔离的情况差别很大。 在这项工作中,我们利用InfantNet和基于SMIL的说明,使这种成人回归网络适应婴儿领域。

blocks.en: 3 InfantNet Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 婴儿网数据集

blocks.en: In this section, we present the InfantNet dataset and detail the data collection and annotation procedures.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍InfantNet数据集并详细介绍数据收集和注释程序。

blocks.en: 3.1 Ethical Design and Data Governance
blocks.zh: 3.1 道德设计和数据治理

blocks.en:
The collection, processing, annotation, and release of InfantNet follow
the IEEE Code of Ethics, with a multi-layer ethical protocol to ensure privacy.
blocks.zh:
FindNet的收集、处理、注释和发布
IEEE道德守则,包含多层道德规范,以确保隐私.

blocks.en: IRB and Consent. The HomeVisit subset was collected under an approved Institutional Review Board (IRB) protocol. We obtained written informed consent from all caregivers, explicitly covering anonymized data sharing for research.
blocks.zh: 移民和难民局与同意。 家庭访问子集是根据经核准的机构审查委员会(IRB)议定书收集的。 我们得到了所有护理人员的书面知情同意,明确涉及为研究共享匿名数据。

blocks.en: Privacy and Anonymization. To protect identities, we apply digital face-masking to all YouTube and HomeVisit frames and strip all identifying metadata. For the YouTube subset, we strictly follow a non-redistribution policy: we release only anonymized, derived data (keypoints, SMIL parameters) and original URLs. Figure shows our face-masking strategy, and more examples can be found in Figure S1 of Appendix A.3 . We also provide experimental results that demonstrate the robustness of our model and viability of our dataset under this strategy in Appendix A.7 .
blocks.zh: 隐私和匿名。 为了保护身份,我们对所有YouTube和HomeVisit的帧进行数字化的面相伪装,并剥去所有识别元数据. 对于YouTube子集,我们严格遵循非再分配政策:我们只发布匿名,衍生出的数据(关键点,SMIL参数)和原始URL. 图中显示了我们的面相遮掩策略,更多实例可参见附录A.3的图S1. 我们还提供了实验结果,表明我们在附录A.7中这一战略下建立的模式和数据集的可行性。

blocks.en: Controlled Access. InfantNet will be released on Hugging Face with gated and manually approved access under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Access requires institutional verification and agreement to a Data Use Agreement prohibiting commercial use, biometric identification, and redistribution of modified derivatives. A dedicated takedown mechanism is maintained for ongoing compliance.
blocks.zh: FindNet将在Hugging Face上发布, 进入要求进行机构核查并商定一项数据使用协议,禁止商业使用、生物鉴别和再分配被修改的衍生物。 为持续遵守,维持了专门的取出机制。

blocks.en: Societal Impact. InfantNet addresses the lack of large-scale resources for infant healthcare research. Our goal is to enable better care for infants while maintaining the highest standards of participant privacy. Specific notes on data and code publications can be found in Appendix A.8 .
blocks.zh: 社会影响. 婴儿网解决了婴儿保健研究缺乏大规模资源的问题。 我们的目标是改善对婴儿的护理,同时保持参与者隐私的最高标准。 关于数据和代码出版物的具体说明见附录A.8。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据收集

blocks.en: YouTube data collection. We curated publicly available infant videos from YouTube, capturing infants in a wide range of poses and body shapes. These raw videos serve as one source of our dataset and are later processed through annotation and quality filtering. The YouTube data is collected strictly following the platform policy and privacy safeguards, as detailed in Sec. 3.1 .
blocks.zh: YouTube数据采集. 我们整理了YouTube上公开的婴儿视频,捕捉各种姿势和身体形状的婴儿。 这些原始视频是我们数据集的一个来源,后来通过注释和质量过滤处理. 如第3.1节所详述,YouTube数据的收集严格遵循平台政策和隐私保障。

blocks.en: HomeVisit Data Collection. Following written informed consent from all caregivers, we recorded multi-view videos of infants in their domestic play areas. The setup used four statically mounted GoPro Hero9 cameras positioned orthogonally for overlap coverage. To support accurate SMIL fitting, we performed rigorous per-session camera calibration. For HomeVisit, the female-to-male video ratio is 47%:53%. We do not infer race, ethnicity, geographic origin, or precise age when such metadata is unavailable.
blocks.zh: Home Visit Data College. (原始内容存档于2018-10-12). 经所有护理人员书面知情同意,我们在家庭游戏区录制了婴儿的多景视频。 该设置使用了四台静态挂载的GoPro Hero9相机正反地定位以进行重叠覆盖. 为了支持准确的SMIL装配,我们进行了严格的每场相机校正. 家庭影视的男女视频比例为47%:53%。 我们不推断种族、族裔、地域或没有这种元数据的确切年龄。

blocks.en: 3.3 Data Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 数据注释

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Annotation pipeline of our InfantNet Dataset. Frames from YouTube and HomeVisit recordings were annotated using a semi-automatic, inspector-guided workflow. For 2D labels, RTMO-L provided initial keypoints that were refined by annotators with iterative quality control, following the COCO format. For 3D labels, we applied an optimization-based method to fit SMIL to infant images, and annotators further filtered the results to ensure accurate pose and shape annotations.
blocks.zh: 图2:我们InfantNet数据集的说明管道。 从YouTube和HomeVisit录制的相框,使用半自动、检查员指导的工作流程作了说明。 对于2D标签,RTMO-L提供了由具有迭代质量控制的注释者按照COCO格式改进的初始关键点. 对于3D标签,我们应用了一种基于优化的方法来将SIL与婴儿图像相匹配,而注释者进一步过滤结果以确保准确的姿势和形状说明.

blocks.en:
We annotated frames from both sources, filtering to ensure exactly one infant per frame and sampling at a maximum rate of 2 FPS to preserve temporal diversity.
In total, 206,436 frames were extracted prior to quality filtering.
The YouTube subset contains 51,039 frames. These videos feature around 25 distinct infants per 4 minutes, yielding an estimated total of around 3,000 unique infants.
The HomeVisit subset consists of 15 multi-camera recording sessions (each with four synchronized cameras), from which 155,397 frames were extracted.
After frame extraction, we performed 2D body keypoint annotation followed by multi-stage quality control, removing frames with severe occlusion, motion blur, or other degradations. The resulting high-quality annotations serve as ground-truth supervision for SMIL fitting and subsequent model training.
blocks.zh:
我们从两个来源都附加了说明的帧,过滤以确保每个帧有一个婴儿,并进行最大速度为2个FPS的取样,以保持时间多样性。
在质量过滤之前共提取出206,436个帧.
YouTube子集包含51,039个帧. 这些录像显示每4分钟约有25个独特的婴儿,估计总共约有3 000个独特的婴儿。
HomeVisit子集由15个多相机录音会话(每个会话有4个同步相机)组成,从中提取出155,397帧.
在取出相框后,我们进行了2D车体键位注释,然后进行多相质量控制,取出相框并有严重隐蔽,运动模糊等退化. 由此产生的高质量说明是对SMIL装配和随后的示范培训的地面实况监督。

blocks.en: To annotate such a large and heterogeneous dataset, we adopted a semi-automatic, inspector-guided annotation pipeline, inspired by human-in-the-loop strategies in 3D model fitting works such as Animal3D [ 43 ] . As shown in Figure 2 , our annotation workflow consisted of six stages to ensure efficiency and accuracy.
blocks.zh: 为了说明如此庞大而多样的数据集,我们采用了一个半自动的、由检查员指导的注解管道,其灵感来源于3D模型配置作品(如Animal3D[43])中的人类即时战略。 如图2所示,我们的说明工作流程包括六个阶段,以确保效率和准确性。

blocks.en: Initial keypoint estimation. We employed RTMO-L [ 31 ] from MMPose [ 11 ] to produce 2D pseudo-labels for all frames. These predictions were loaded into CVAT [ 10 ] , where human annotators conducted multi-step refinement.
blocks.zh: 初步关键点估计。 我们使用来自MMPose的RTMO-L [31] 来制作所有帧的2D伪标签. 这些预测被装入CVAT [10],人类的注释者在那里进行了多步骤的改进.

blocks.en: Initial filtering and manual correction. Annotators reviewed the RTMO-L [ 31 ] predictions in CVAT and removed frames with severe motion blur, camera shake, extreme lighting artifacts (e.g., overexposure or harsh shadows), strong occlusion (e.g., when the infant is mostly outside the field of view or heavily covered by objects), missing infants, or subjects older than 18 months. Adult skeletons were discarded, and one infant per frame was retained. For remaining frames, if the RTMO-L prediction provided accurate and anatomically plausible keypoints, the annotation was accepted without modification to maximize efficiency. Otherwise, annotators manually corrected the predictions to ensure anatomical consistency. All annotations followed the COCO format with 17 joints: nose, left eye, right eye, left ear, right ear, left shoulder, right shoulder, left elbow, right elbow, left wrist, right wrist, left hip, right hip, left knee, right knee, left ankle, and right ankle. Each keypoint was tagged as visible , partially occluded , or fully occluded .
blocks.zh: 初步过滤和人工修正。 注释者审查了CVAT中的RTMO-L [31] 预测,并移除了带有严重运动模糊,相机摇晃,极端照明文物(例如过度曝光或严酷的阴影),强烈被隔离(例如当婴儿大多在视野外或被物体大量覆盖时),失踪的婴儿,或超过18个月的被子. 成人骨架被丢弃,每帧留一婴儿. 对于其余的框架,如果RTMO-L预测提供了准确和解剖上可信的关键点,则不加修改地接受注释,以最大限度地提高效率。 否则,注释者会手动修正预测,以确保解剖的一致性. 所有注解都遵循COCO格式,有17个关节:鼻子,左眼,右眼,左耳,右耳,左肩,右肩,左肘,右肘,左腕,右腕,左臀,右膝,右踝. 每个键被标记为可见、部分被占用或完全被占用。

blocks.en: Inspector verification. An inspector reviewed annotations for consistency and quality. Frames with annotation errors were returned to annotators with revision feedback.
blocks.zh: 2. 核查检查员。 一位检查专员审查了说明的一致性和质量。 带有注释错误的框架被退回给有修订反馈的注释者。

blocks.en: Iterative refinement. This correction–verification cycle was repeated until the inspector approved all annotations per recording session, ensuring high-quality labels.
blocks.zh: 直取精进. 在检查员批准每次录音的所有说明之前,重复了这种更正核查周期,以确保标签的质量。

blocks.en: Bounding box generation. Once the keypoints were finalized, bounding boxes were generated using SAM2 [ 38 ] . Visible keypoints were used to prompt mask generation, and the final bounding boxes were computed as the minimal rectangles covering both the masks and any occluded joints, thereby mitigating segmentation errors due to occlusion (e.g., infants partially covered by furniture).

blocks.en: This staged workflow allowed us to balance scalability and precision, producing high-quality 2D annotations with explicit human oversight at each critical step. Examples of the 2D annotations in different stages are shown in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 这一分阶段的工作流程使我们能够平衡可伸缩性和精确性,产生高质量的2D说明,并在每个关键步骤都明确受到人的监督。 图3显示不同阶段的2D说明实例。

blocks.en: 3.4 Fitting SMIL on Infant Images
blocks.zh: 3.4 婴儿图像的组合SMIL

blocks.en: The registration proceeds in three steps: estimating initial shape, solving per-frame poses with smoothness and data terms, and registering meshes via constrained deformation. We validate SMIL parameters with multi-view rendering and reprojection checks, removing results inconsistent with the image, distorted in any view, or showing implausible poses or shapes. We also project 3D keypoints to 2D and discard frames with reprojection error above 16 pixels. The filtered parameters provide high-quality 3D ground-truth for end-to-end training. Further 3D annotation quality analysis is provided in Sec. 3.5 .
blocks.zh: 登记分三个步骤进行:估计初始形状,用平滑和数据术语解决每个框架的构成,以及通过受限制的变形登记网格。 我们通过多视图渲染和再投影检查验证SMIL参数,去除与图像不一致的结果,在任何视图中被扭曲,或者显示不可信的外观或形状. 我们还将3D键点投影到2D并丢弃帧,再投影误差超过16像素. 被过滤的参数为端到端培训提供了高质量的3D地真. 3D注释质量分析载于第3.5节。

blocks.en: Format. All annotations follow the standard COCO [ 28 ] keypoints format and include 17 body keypoints with visibility flags (visible, partially occluded, fully occluded), as well as bounding boxes. The dataset’s multi-source and multi-view composition enables both robust training and principled benchmarking in this challenging domain.
blocks.zh: 形式。 所有说明都遵循了标准的COCO [28] 键点格式,并包括了17个有能见度旗帜(可见,部分被占用,完全被占用)的正体键点以及边框. 数据集的多来源和多视角组成使得能够在这个具有挑战性的领域进行强有力的培训和制定原则基准。

blocks.en: Pose Diversity. We measure pose diversity as the average standard deviation of pelvis-centered 3D joint coordinates across the dataset, capturing spatial variability of articulated body parts, including joint distribution, pose spread, and limb movement range [ 27 ] . The 3D annotations achieve a pose diversity score of 115.0 , exceeding several widely used large-scale human datasets (Fig. 4 ) and demonstrating substantial structural variability despite focusing on infants. Prior to multi-view rendering and reprojection-based filtering (Sec. 3.4 ), the pose diversity score is 138.2. The post-filtering diversity remains at a high magnitude, confirming that the filtering process preserves pose variability and does not bias the dataset toward specific poses or shapes.

blocks.en: 3D Annotation Quality. We validate the 3D annotations from consistency and reliability. We assess consistency using multi-view rendering, reprojection error, and bbox-normalized PCK. The 3D annotations achieve a mean reprojection error of 9.10 px and 83.04%/98.40%/99.99% PCK@0.05/0.1/0.2 . We evaluate reliability using multi-view joint optimization on calibrated HomeVisit frames. We jointly optimize each body annotation across views using multi-view reprojection error and SMIL priors. The optimized annotations differ from initial annotations by 80.6 mm MPJPE, while independently optimized candidates agree closely with only 3.1 mm mean pairwise MPJPE, supporting 3D annotation reliability.
blocks.zh: 3D 注释质量. 我们从一致性和可靠性的角度验证三维说明。 我们利用多视图渲染,再投射错误,以及bbox-正态化的PCK来评估一致性. 3D说明实现了9.10 px和83.04%/98.40%/99.99%PCK@0.05/0.1/0.2的中间再预测误差. 我们利用对校准的自视帧的多视图联合优化来评价可靠性。 我们利用多视图再投影错误和SMIL前科,共同优化了每个机构对各种观点的说明。 优化后的说明与初始说明不同为80.6毫米MPJPE,而独立优化后的候选人则与只有3.1毫米正对相机的MPJPE关系密切,支持了3D注释的可靠性.

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We benchmark state-of-the-art 2D and 3D pose estimation models on InfantNet to quantify the domain gap between adult-centric models and infant morphology. Secs. 4.1 and 4.2 evaluate 2D transferability and 3D recovery, while Sec. 4.3 shows InfantNet’s value in real-world applications.
blocks.zh: 我们以最新2D和3D为基准在InfantNet上提出估算模型,以量化以成人为中心的模型与婴儿形态之间的域间差距。 第4.1和4.2节评价2D可转移性和3D恢复,而第4.3节显示InfindNet在现实世界应用中的价值。

blocks.en: 4.1 2D Keypoint Estimation
blocks.zh: 4.1 2D 关键点估计

blocks.en: We benchmark a series of widely used 2D human pose estimation models on our proposed infant dataset to evaluate their ability to transfer from adult-centric data to the unique morphology and movement patterns of infants.
blocks.zh: 我们以我们拟议的婴儿数据集为基准,制定一系列广泛使用的二维人姿势估计模型,以评估他们从以成人为中心的数据转移到婴儿独特的形态和运动模式的能力。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Comparison of 2D pose estimation models on the InfantNet benchmark under two settings: direct inference using pretrained models and fine-tuning on InfantNet. We report Average Precision (AP), AP at IoU thresholds 0.5 (AP.5) and 0.75 (AP.75), and Average Recall (AR). Direct transfer of pretrained models leads to a clear performance drop, while fine-tuning consistently improves performance, with an average relative gain of 6.2% in AP and 5.2% in AR . We benchmark a wide range of 2D pose estimation models on InfantNet under two settings: (1) direct inference using COCO-pretrained weights, and (2) fine-tuning the models on our InfantNet training set. Table 3 summarizes the Average Precision (AP), Average Recall (AR), and their variants across 25 different configurations.

blocks.en:
(a) Direct Inference Results. Sapiens achieves the highest AP (0.9008), while ViTPose-large and ViTPose-huge achieve the best AR (0.9199). HRNet-W48-Dark 256x192 is also competitive (AP: 0.8892, AR: 0.9069).
Overall, transformer-based models, particularly Sapiens and ViTPose, show the best direct transfer to InfantNet.

(a) 直接推断结果。 萨皮恩斯实现了最高的AP(0.9008),而ViTPose-大和ViTPose-huge则实现了最佳AR(0.9199). HRNet-W48-Dark 256x192也具有竞争力(AP:0.8892,AR:0.9069).
总的来说,基于变压器的模型,特别是Sapians和ViTPose,显示了最好的直接传输到InfantNet.

blocks.en: (b) Fine-tuning on InfantNet. Fine-tuning consistently boosts performance across models. On average, it yields a relative gain of 6.2% in AP and 5.2% in AR compared to direct inference. The ViTPose-huge model again achieves the best performance (AP: 0.9477, AR: 0.9582) after fine-tuning. Overall, models with higher input resolution outperform lower-resolution counterparts, demonstrating the importance of spatial detail for infant pose estimation.
blocks.zh: (b) 对InfantNet进行微调。 微调不断提升跨模型性能. 平均而言,与直接推论相比,该物质在AP的相对收益为6.2%,在AR的相对收益为5.2%。 ViTPose-huge模型在微调后再次实现了最佳性能(AP:0.9477,AR:0.9582). 总体而言,投入分辨率较高的模型比低分辨率模型要好,表明空间细节对婴儿的重要性。

blocks.en: (c) Source-specific and Cross-domain Evaluation. We evaluate model performance separately on the YouTube and HomeVisit subsets. For each source, we measure direct inference using COCO-pretrained weights, fine-tuning only on the InfantNet training portion of that source, and cross-domain generalization, where models are fine-tuned on one source (e.g., HomeVisit) and evaluated on the other (e.g., YouTube). Fine-tuning yields a relative gain of 6.1% in AP and 5.3% in AR on HomeVisit and 5.0% in AP and 3.7% in AR on YouTube. The source-specific and cross-domain comparison table is provided in Appendix Table S1 and S2 .
blocks.zh: (c) 特定来源和跨领域评价。 我们在YouTube和Homevisit子集上分别评价模型性能. 对于每个来源,我们使用COCO预受器重来测量直接推论,仅对该来源的InfantNet培训部分进行微调,并进行跨域通论,其中模型在一个来源(如HomeVisit)上被微调,在另一个来源上被评价(如YouTube). 微调后,AP的相对收益为6.1%,AR的相对收益为5.3%,AP的相对收益为5.0%,AR的相对收益为3.7%。 附录表S1和S2提供了特定来源和跨域比较表。

blocks.en: Failure Mode Analysis. Models without InfantNet fine-tuning fail on infant-specific poses (e.g., high flexibility), limb proportions (shorter limbs relative to torso), and self-occlusions (Fig. 5 ). After FT, models locate joints correctly.
blocks.zh: 失败模式分析。 没有InfantNet的模型在针对婴儿的姿势(如高度灵活性)、肢体比例(相对于躯干更短的肢体)和自我隔离(图5)上的微调失败。 FT之后,模型正确定位关节.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Failure modes and effects of fine-tuning: Without InfantNet FT, keypoint estimators frequently fail, e.g., by mislocalizing the left arm under severe self-occlusion (left) or predicting leg incorrectly in atypical infant poses (right). After FT, models can accurately localize joints in these challenging scenarios.
blocks.zh: 图5:微调的失败模式和效果:没有InfantNet FT, 关键点估计器经常出故障,例如,在严重自我隔离(左)下错位左臂,或者在非典型婴儿外形(右)下预言腿部不正确. 在FT之后,模型可以在这些有挑战性的情景中精确地将关节本地化.

blocks.en: Hardest Joints. Joint PCK statistics across body parts (Table 5 ) show that leg joints are the most challenging. Before fine-tuning, ViTPose-H achieves the lowest PCK on legs (0.793), compared to head (0.962), torso (0.842), and arms (0.865). Fine-tuning on InfantNet improves performance across all regions, including legs (0.793 → \rightarrow 0.828), yet lower limbs remain challenging. This gap highlights challenges in infant pose estimation, including large articulation, different body proportions from adults, and frequent occlusions.
blocks.zh: 最难关节。 跨体段的PCK联合统计数据(表5)显示,腿关节最具挑战性. 在微调之前,ViTPose-H在腿上实现了最低的PCK(0.793),相较于头部(0.962),躯干(0.842)和武器(0.865). InfantNet的微调提高了所有区域的性能,包括腿部(0.793 ~\正中0.828),但下肢仍然具有挑战性。 这一差距凸显出婴儿构成估计方面的挑战,包括大范围表述、身体比例与成年人不同以及经常被隔离。

blocks.en: Table 5 : PCK (%) breakdown of ViTPose-H before and after fine-tuning on InfantNet. Fine-tuning improves all body parts, but leg joints remain the most challenging, reflecting the unique articulation and occlusion patterns in infant poses.
blocks.zh: 表5:在InfanteNet微调前后的ViTPose-H分类数据(%)。 微调改善所有身体部位,但腿关节仍然是最有挑战性的,反映了婴儿姿势中独特的表达和隔离模式.

blocks.en: 4.2 3D Pose and Shape Estimation
blocks.zh: 4.2 三维波斯和形状估计

blocks.en:
We further benchmark representative 3D pose and shape estimation models on our proposed InfantNet dataset to assess their generalizability to infant body models, establishing baselines for 3D infant pose and shape estimation.
Notably, a direct comparison with previous infant datasets is not possible, as InfantNet is the first to provide the high-quality 3D ground truth required for such evaluation (see Table 1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们进一步根据拟议的婴儿网络数据集制定基准3D模型和形状估计模型,以评估这些模型对婴儿身体模型的可通用性,确定3D婴儿姿势和形状估计的基线。
值得注意的是,无法与以前的婴儿数据集进行直接比较,因为InfantNet是第一个提供这种评估所需的高质量三维地面真相的网络(见表1)。

blocks.en: Setup. While no algorithms are explicitly designed for 3D infant pose and shape estimation, adult-based models can be adapted to infants. We benchmark CNN-based HMR [ 22 ] and PARE [ 25 ] , and transformer-based 4D-Humans [ 15 ] as baselines. We provide a detailed analysis comparing end-to-end regression with SMIL-based optimization in Appendix A.6 . We train each model for 100 epochs using a learning rate of 2.5 × 10 − 5 2.5\times 10^{-5} for HMR and PARE on 3 NVIDIA TITAN RTX GPUs, and a learning rate of 2.0 × 10 − 5 2.0\times 10^{-5} for 4D-Humans on 4 NVIDIA A5000 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 设相. 虽然没有明确为3D婴儿姿势和外形估计设计出算法,但基于成人的模型可以被适应于婴儿. 我们把基于CNN的HMR[22]和价调汇率[25]作为基准,把基于变压器的4D-Humans[15]作为基准. 我们提供了详细的分析,将端到端回归与附录A.6中基于SMIL的优化进行比较。 我们为100个世纪的每个模型进行训练, 使用 2.5 × 10 − 5 2.5\times 10× 5 } 3 NVIDIA TITAN RTX GPU上的 HMR 和 PRED 的学习率, 4 NVIDIA A5000 GPU上的4D-Human的学习率 2.0 × 10 − 5 2.0\times 10× 5 }。

blocks.en: Evaluation. We evaluate models with standard 3D human pose and shape estimation metrics. We report mean per joint position error (MPJPE) in mm, which measures the absolute error between predicted and ground-truth 3D joint positions, and Procrustes-aligned mean per joint position error (PA-MPJPE) in mm, which evaluates relative joint configuration error after rigid alignment.
blocks.zh: 评价。 我们用标准的3D人类姿势和形状估计度量来评价模型. 我们报告每个联合位置误差(MPJPE)以毫米表示,它测量了预测到的和地上真实的3D联合位置之间的绝对误差,以及每个联合位置误差(PA-MPJPE)以毫米表示的Procrustes-accessive平均误差,它评价了刚性对齐后相对的联合配置误差.

blocks.en: Model & Data Preparation. We train the models on 10,071 frames and evaluate on 1,571 frames. HMR and 4D-Humans are trained with both 2D and 3D supervision. For PARE, we segment the mean SMIL mesh into seven parts with Blender [ 2 ] for part-attention and mask supervision.
blocks.zh: 模型和数据准备。 我们用10,071帧对模型进行训练,并对1,571帧进行评估。 HMR和4D-Human都接受了2D和3D监督的培训. 就价调汇率而言,我们把平均SMIL网格分成七个部分,用Blender[2]进行部分注意和口罩监督。

blocks.en: Results. We benchmark 3D human pose and shape estimation models on InfantNet under two settings: (1) training and inference with SMIL-adapted weights, and (2) direct inference with pretrained adult-model weights. Fig. 6 presents visualizations of both settings. Table 4 reports MPJPE and PA-MPJPE across six configurations.
blocks.zh: 结果。 我们在两个场合下将3D人类姿势和外形估计模型作为基准:(1) 培训和推论与适应SMIL的重量;(2) 直接推论与训练有素的成人模型重量。 图6展示了两种设置的可视化. 表4列出了MPJPE和PA-MPJPE的六个配置。

blocks.en: (a) Adult Body Model. Direct inference using human pose and shape estimation models yields lower accuracy compared to results obtained with infant-specific body models, affirming the domain gap between adult and infant poses and shapes. Among adult-centric models, PARE achieves the strongest performance (MPJPE: 364.49 mm, PA-MPJPE: 120.06 mm), while its accuracy remains considerably lower than when trained with infant body models.
blocks.zh: (a) 成人身体模型。 使用人体姿势和外形估计模型的直接推论,与针对婴儿的身体模型所获得的结果相比,其准确度较低,证实了成人和婴儿的姿势和外形之间的域差距。 在以成人为中心的模型中,价调汇率实现最强性能(MPJPE:364.49毫米,PA-MPJPE:120.06毫米),而其精度仍然比接受婴儿身体模型培训时要低得多.

blocks.en: (b) Infant Body Model. Adapting adult-oriented models to SMIL substantially improves performance across all architectures. On average, there is a 78% reduction in MPJPE and 54% reduction in PA-MPJPE compared to direct adult-model inference. We provide cross-subset results in Appendix A.5 , demonstrating strong cross-domain generalization. Our infant-specific estimations are almost as good as adult-based estimations (e.g., HMR reports 87.97 mm MPJPE on Human3.6M). Among the models, 4D-Humans achieves the strongest results (MPJPE: 84.73 mm, PA-MPJPE: 46.74 mm), likely due to transformer-based global reasoning. In comparison, keypoint-only ZeDO-i [ 48 ] achieves 97.1/77.3 mm. These results show our adapted models provide a better geometric prior for the infant body than adult-oriented models. To ensure privacy, digital facial masking is added. Additional experiments show negligible performance changes (approximately 1-5 mm) with masking, and details are provided in Appendix A.7 . These adapted end-to-end models establish a new state-of-the-art for monocular 3D infant pose and shape estimation, providing a solid foundation for applications in developmental monitoring, childcare, and early medical diagnosis.
blocks.zh: (b) 婴儿身体模型。 使面向成人的模型适应SMIL,大大提高了所有建筑的性能. 平均而言,与直接的成人模型推论相比,成人-成人-青少年-青少年-青少年-青少年-青少年-青少年-青少年-青少年-青少年-青少年-青少年减少78%。 我们在附录A.5中提供了交叉子集结果,显示了强烈的跨域通论. 我们针对婴儿的估计数几乎与基于成年人的估计数相同(例如,HMR报告关于Human3.6M的87.97毫米MPJPE)。 在模型中,4D-Humans取得了最强的结果(MPJPE:84.73毫米,PA-MPJPE:46.74毫米),可能是由于以变压器为基础的全球推理. 相比之下,只有键点的ZeDO-i [48] 达到了97.1/77.3毫米,这些结果显示,我们经过调整的模型为婴儿身体提供了比面向成年人的模型更好的几何前身。 为了确保隐私,增加了数码面相面具. 其他实验显示,带有口罩的性能变化微不足道(约1至5毫米),详情见附录A.7。 这些经过调整的端到端模型为单体3D婴儿姿势和外形估计建立了新的先进水平,为在发育监测、儿童保育和早期医学诊断方面的应用奠定了坚实的基础。

blocks.en: 4.3 Real-world Application
blocks.zh: 4.3 现实世界应用

blocks.en: To demonstrate InfantNet’s practical impact, we evaluate its performance on detecting hand-to-mouth (HTM) behavior, a critical indicator of environmental exposure ( e.g. , soil/dust ingestion) [ 32 , 33 ] . Using 3D estimates from our framework, we identify HTM events via normalized hand-to-mouth Euclidean distances. Our infant-specific 4D-Humans model achieves 83% detection accuracy, compared to 30% of the adult-oriented baseline. This performance gap confirms that anatomical fidelity is not merely a refinement but a prerequisite for reliable infant behavior analysis and risk assessment in real-world settings.
blocks.zh: 为了证明InfantNet的实际影响,我们评价其在检测手对口行为(HTM)方面的表现,这是环境接触(例如土壤/灰尘摄入)的关键指标[32、33]。 利用我们框架内的3D估计,我们通过正常的手对口欧几利得距离来识别HTM事件. 我们的婴儿特异性4D-Humans模型实现了83%的检测精度,而以成人为导向的基线的30%. 这一性能差距证实,解剖忠诚不仅仅是一种改进,而且是在现实世界环境中进行可靠的婴儿行为分析和风险评估的先决条件。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce InfantNet, the first large-scale dataset dedicated to infant pose and shape estimation, addressing the limitations of existing adult-centric models in this domain. Our results show that adult-trained models generalize poorly to infant morphology, while training on InfantNet effectively bridges this gap, enabling accurate 2D and 3D estimation. Beyond benchmarking, our framework provides a reliable foundation for downstream healthcare applications, such as quantifying infant hand-to-mouth behavior for exposure risk assessment.
While our current 3D subset provides a rigorous foundation, we aim to scale the dataset significantly by implementing a human-in-the-loop active learning framework. This will allow for the efficient expansion of high-quality 3D labels across more diverse domestic environments and ages.
Developed under strict ethical oversight with digital face-masking and controlled access, InfantNet is designed for responsible research. By releasing our data, models, and evaluation tools, we provide a standardized platform to advance infant-focused vision models, and ultimately foster positive impact in both academic research and pediatric care.
blocks.zh:
我们引进了InfantNet,这是第一个专门处理婴儿姿势和形状估计的大型数据集,解决这一领域现有以成人为中心的模型的局限性。 我们的结果显示,经过成人培训的模型对婴儿形态学的概括性很差,而关于InfantNet的培训有效地弥合了这一差距,从而能够进行准确的2D和3D估计。 除了制定基准外,我们的框架还为下游的保健应用提供了可靠的基础,例如量化婴儿的手对口行为进行接触风险评估。
虽然我们目前的3D子集提供了一个严格的基础,但我们的目标是通过实施一个人入行动积极学习框架,大大地扩大数据集。 这将使高质量的三维标签能够有效地扩展到更加多样化的国内环境和年龄。
InfantNet是在严格的道德监督下开发的,并配备了数码假面和受控访问功能,它旨在进行负责任的研究。 通过发布我们的数据、模型和评价工具,我们提供了一个标准化的平台,以推进以婴儿为重点的愿景模型,并最终在学术研究和儿科护理方面促进积极影响。

blocks.en: We next evaluate cross-subset generalization by fine-tuning on one source and testing on the other. This setting allows us to assess the robustness of each model under domain shift. blocks.en: Fine-tuning on HomeVisit and Evaluating on YouTube. Fine-tuning on the HomeVisit subset produces only marginal gains on the YouTube test set, with an average relative gain of 0.5% in AP and 0.3% in AR . This limited increase is expected and reflects a clear domain mismatch: HomeVisit videos feature fixed viewpoints, stable lighting, and clean indoor scenes, whereas YouTube videos contain far greater variability in camera motion, compression artifacts, occlusions, and infant appearance. Consequently, models fine-tuned on HomeVisit adapt to a simpler and narrower distribution, offering little transfer to the more complex YouTube subset. Higher-capacity models still show modest improvements. ViTPose-huge reaches the highest AP (0.9347) and the highest AR (0.9521) after fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 在YouTube上对"家访与评价"进行精细调整. 对HomeVisit子集的微调只产生YouTube测试集的边际收益,AP的平均相对收益为0.5%,AR为0.3%. 这一有限的增加是预期的,并反映出一个明显的域错配: 而YouTube的影片在相机运动、压缩文物、隔离和婴儿外观方面, 因此,对HomeVisit上的模型进行了微调,以适应更简单、更窄的分布,很少向更复杂的YouTube子集转移。 产能较高的模型仍然显示出适度的改进. ViTPose-huge在微调后达到最高AP(0.9347)和最高AR(0.9521).

blocks.en: Fine-tuning on YouTube and Evaluating on HomeVisit. Fine-tuning on the YouTube train set leads to substantial improvements on the HomeVisit test set, with an average relative gain of 5.2% in AP and 4.7% in AR . It reflects the fact that YouTube provides a larger and more diverse training distribution that transfers effectively to the more controlled HomeVisit subset. All model families benefit consistently from this direction of adaptation. Transformer-based architectures exhibit the largest absolute performance, with ViTPose-large and ViTPose-huge reaching AP values of 0.9347 and 0.9362, respectively, after fine-tuning. Overall, these results demonstrate a clear asymmetry in cross-subset transfer: training on the more complex and diverse YouTube domain significantly boosts performance on the HomeVisit subset, whereas the reverse direction yields only marginal gains. This highlights the value of high-variability data for robust infant pose estimation.
blocks.zh: 在YouTube上进行精细调整,并在Homevisit上进行评价. YouTube列车的精细调整使得Homevisit测试集有了实质性的改进,AP的平均相对收益为5.2%,AR为4.7%. 它反映了一个事实,即YouTube提供了更大、更多样化的培训分布,有效地向受更控制的HomeVisit子集转移。 所有模范家庭始终从这一适应方向中受益。 基于变形器的架构表现出了最大的绝对性能,经过微调后,ViTPose-大和ViTPose-huge分别达到AP值0.9347和0.9362. 总体而言,这些结果表明交叉子集传输中存在明显的不对称性:关于更复杂和多样化的YouTube域的培训大大提升了HomeVisit子集的性能,而反向只产生微小收益. 这凸显出高可变性数据对稳健的婴儿布局估计的价值。

blocks.en: A.6 End-to-End vs Optimization
blocks.zh: A.6 端到端对端优化

blocks.en: To evaluate the benefits of learning-based 3D infant pose and shape estimation, we compare our end-to-end models from Sec. 4.2 against the optimization-based SMIL fitting process used to generate ground-truth 3D annotations in Sec. 3.4 . This comparison highlights two key aspects for end-to-end models: inference efficiency and robustness to cases where optimization fails or produces severely deformed meshes. By evaluating inference speed and estimation quality, we demonstrate that end-to-end regression not only achieves faster inference, but also yields more reliable estimations, reflecting the practical values of end-to-end models for 3D infant modeling.
blocks.zh: 为了评价基于学习的3D婴儿姿势和形状估计的好处,我们将4.2 Sec的端到端模型与用于生成Sec中地真3D说明的基于优化的SMIL配位过程进行比较. 3.4 (中文(简体) ). 这一比较突出了端到端模型的两个关键方面:对优化失败或产生严重畸形的介质案例的推论效率和稳健性. 通过评价推断速度和估计质量,我们表明端到端回归不仅能实现更快的推断,而且能产生更可靠的估计,反映了3D婴儿模型的端到端模型的实际值.

blocks.en: From Table S4 , end-to-end models are significantly faster than optimization-based SMIL fitting in terms of inference. While optimization requires an average of 38.7020 seconds per image for inference, end-to-end models operate in the millisecond range, with HMR achieving the fastest speed ( ≈ 3.25 \approx 3.25 ms). The results clearly demonstrate the efficiency of end-to-end regression, enabling real-time inference that optimization-based methods cannot achieve.
blocks.zh: 从表S4来看,端到端的模型在推论上明显快于基于优化的SMIL相配. 虽然优化需要每个图像平均38.7020秒的推想,但端到端模型运行在毫秒范围内,而HMR实现最快的速度(QQ 3.25\相差3.25ms). 结果清楚地表明了端到端回归的效率,使得基于优化的方法无法实现实时推论.

blocks.en: We conduct this experiment to evaluate the reliability of end-to-end regression in cases where optimization-based SMIL fitting fails. As shown in Figure S3 , optimization outputs exhibit mesh distortions, such as implausible limb articulations and inconsistent body proportions. In contrast, the end-to-end 4D-Humans model produces anatomically coherent meshes that align better with the underlying infant silhouette. The results highlight the practical significance of learning-based regression, yielding more reliable 3D infant pose and shape estimations.
blocks.zh: 在基于优化的SMIL安装失败的情况下,我们进行这项实验,以评估端到端回归的可靠性. 如图S3所示,优化输出会呈现网格扭曲,如不可信的四肢通缩和身体比例不一致. 相形之下,端到端的4D-Humans模型产生解剖学上相通的间隙,更能与所蕴藏的婴儿相配合. 结果突出了基于学习的回归的实际意义,从而产生了更可靠的3D婴儿姿势和形状估计。

blocks.en: Table S4 : Comparison of average inference speed between optimization-based SMIL fitting and end-to-end infant modeling models. End-to-end models achieve millisecond-level inference, demonstrating the substantial computational advantage of learning-based 3D infant pose and shape estimation models.
blocks.zh: 表S4:基于优化的SMIL装配和端到端婴儿模型之间的平均推导速度比较. 端到端模型实现毫秒级推论,证明了基于学习的3D婴儿姿势和形状估计模型的巨大计算优势.

blocks.en: Figure S3 : Visualization of 3D pose and shape estimation model performances. The columns from left to right: the input image, optimization-based SMIL fitting, and inference with end-to-end model (4D-Humans [ 15 ] ) trained with infant body model and data, respectively. The end-to-end 4D-Humans model produces anatomically plausible meshes that better align with the infant silhouette, while optimization-based SMIL fitting produces deformed meshes, illustrating the robustness of end-to-end models in 3D infant estimation compared to optimization-based fitting.
blocks.zh: 图S3:可视化3D平面和形状估计模型性能. 从左到右的列:输入图像,以优化为基础的SMIL相接,并分别以受过婴儿身体模型和数据培训的端到端模型(4D-Humans [15])推论. 由端到端的4D-Humans模型产生解剖学上可信的介质来更好地与婴儿的 silhouette相配合,而以优化为基础的SMIL相接则产生畸形的介质,说明与以优化为基础的相接方式相比,3D相接婴儿估计中端到端模型的强性.

blocks.en: A.7 3D Evaluation with Face-Masked Data
blocks.zh: A.7 3D 面部扫描数据评价

blocks.en: We evaluate the impact of privacy-preserving face masking on 3D infant pose and shape estimation. This experiment assesses the robustness of the proposed end-to-end infant models to masked inputs and the research viability of our anonymized dataset for accurate 3D infant pose and shape estimation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价保护隐私面罩对3D婴儿姿势和形状估计的影响。 这一实验评估了拟议中的从端到端婴儿模型的稳健性,以掩盖投入,并评估了我们用于准确的3D婴儿姿势和形状估计的匿名数据集的研究可行性。

blocks.en: We again follow the same train and evaluation protocol described in Sec. 4.2 , using identical model configurations and evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们再次遵循第4.2节所述的同样的火车和评价协议,使用相同的模型配置和评价指标。

blocks.en: We train and evaluate the models with the same set of data described in Sec. 4.2 , replacing the input images with versions in which the face regions are masked using our privacy-preserving pipeline. The masking removes identifiable facial features such as eyes and noses while preserving the overall appearance of the head and body contours, thereby retaining the visual cues for accurate 3D estimation.
blocks.zh: 我们用第4.2节中描述的同一组数据来训练和评价模型,将输入图像取而代之的是使用我们保护隐私的管道掩盖面部区域的版本。 口罩可以去除可识别的面部特征,如眼睛和鼻子等,同时保留了头部和身体轮廓的整体外观,从而保留了视觉提示来进行准确的3D估计.

blocks.en: As shown in Table S5 , masking-based anonymization does not introduce systematic degradation in 3D infant pose and shape estimation, with performance variations limited to approximately 1–5 mm compared to the original results in Sec. 4.2 . HMR and PARE exhibit slight improvements under masked inputs (e.g., PARE improves from 83.73 mm to 78.48 mm in MPJPE), while 4D-Humans shows a marginal decrease (84.73 mm to 86.57 mm in MPJPE). The improvements observed for the CNN-based models (HMR, PARE) may stem from their reliance on structural cues, and suppressing high-frequency facial details removes visual noise without affecting overall geometry. In contrast, the small performance drop for 4D-Humans suggests the sensitivity to fine-grained local texture cues of attention-based architecture. The minimal impact of anonymization indicates that the masking procedure preserves essential structural and geometric cues required for accurate 3D reconstruction, while effectively removing identifiable facial information. These findings validate both the robustness of our models and the viability of our privacy-preserving dataset design.

HMR和价调汇率在蒙面投入下略有改善(例如价调汇率在MPJPE中从83.73毫米提高到78.48毫米),而4D-Humans则显示略有下降(MPJPE中84.73毫米下降到86.57毫米). 所观察到的有线电视新闻网模型(HMR,PADE)的改进可能源于其对结构提示的依赖,压制高频面部细节可以去除视觉噪声而不影响整体几何. 相比之下,4D-Humans的小型性能下降表明对以关注为主的建筑的精细纹理提示的敏感性. 匿名化的最小影响表明,遮掩程序保留了精确3D重建所需的基本结构和几何提示,同时有效去除可识别面部信息. 这些结论证实了我们模型的稳健性以及我们保护隐私数据集设计的可行性。

blocks.en: A.8 Public Release
blocks.zh: A.8 公开发布

blocks.en: To support future research in 3D infant modeling, we plan to release all the annotations of the training and evaluation data, with strict privacy safeguards upon acceptance of this paper, and checkpoints of the models fine-tuned on our InfantNet.
blocks.zh: 为了支持未来3D婴儿模型的研究,我们计划发布培训和评估数据的所有说明,并在接受本文后严格保护隐私,并在我们的InfantNet上对模型进行微调的检查站。

blocks.en: We will release the implementation of our data processing and end-to-end 3D infant pose and shape estimation models for reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 我们将公布我们的数据处理和端到端的3D婴儿姿势的执行情况,并公布可复制的模型。
